excluded..changefiles: Pending release notes; promotion consumes them into version bumps before composing Main.
excluded.efforts: Contributor planning records. No install, runtime, promotion or candidate test path reads them.

excluded_patterns.*/libs/*/tests: Tests inside a vendored library copy. Installs and runtimes read only the copy's src and pyproject; vendored-sync checks compare src; no runner, workflow or consumer runs them; the canonical libs/<lib>/tests stay released.
excluded_patterns.*/*/libs/*/tests: Tests inside a vendored library copy. Installs and runtimes read only the copy's src and pyproject; vendored-sync checks compare src; no runner, workflow or consumer runs them; the canonical libs/<lib>/tests stay released.
